prayerExcerpt.en-US: "Jesus visits me every morning in Communion; I return the visit in the poor way I can, by visiting the poor."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Jesus me visita todas as manhãs na Comunhão; eu retribuo a visita do modo pobre que posso, visitando os pobres."

meta.face: A young Turinese of twenty-four, clean-shaven, with a warm olive complexion and a BROAD, SQUARE face — a low, wide forehead under thick, glossy black hair brushed UP and back from the brow and cut short at the sides, THICK, straight, nearly level black brows set LOW over deep-set, dark, steady eyes, a strong, straight nose with a broad bridge, broad, flat cheekbones, full lips closed in a slight smile, and a strong, SQUARE chin; the gaze open, frank and cheerful. A sturdy young man, not a soft, slender, beardless youth like aloysius_gonzaga.
meta.basis: His photographs (Wikimedia Commons: the arms-crossed portrait from Luciana Frassati's 'Una vita in immagini', the climbing photographs of 1924-25; the Dicastery's portrait): a broad, square face under thick black hair brushed up, thick low level brows over deep-set eyes, a strong straight nose, full lips and a square chin. The rope and ice axe are for the climbs he made with friends; the Dicastery recalls that on his last mountain photograph, in the Val di Lanzo, he wrote 'Verso l'alto'.
meta.excerpt: His words «Gesù mi fa visita ogni mattina nella Comunione, io la restituisco nel misero modo che posso, visitando i poveri», quoted on the Dicastery's page; our rendering (he died in 1925)

sources.title: Dicastery for the Causes of Saints, Pier Giorgio Frassati (biography; 'Verso l'alto')
